title: SGA: Working Translation, Source-Repair, and Audit Drafts (SGA6 idx645 Source-Rescribe Checkpoint)
description:
This is the reader-facing SGA working record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. It retains the compact SGA5 and SGA6 reader-first surface and updates the front SGA6 French source-rescribe workpass to certification-ledger entry #662, scan idx645 / volume p632 / Expose XIII p17. The next unchecked page is idx646 / volume p633 / Expose XIII p18.

Open first: the SGA5 French workpass PDF, 01_SGA6_French_SourceRescribe_Workpass_NotCertified_idx645_20260716.pdf, and the SGA6 English unsynchronized working-draft PDF. File 04_SGA6_TeX_SourceRescribe_Audit_NotCertified_idx645_20260716.zip contains editable French TeX, certification and errata ledgers, clean compile logs, a 37-page high-resolution source witness, boundary images, rendered output checks, PDF-text readback evidence, checksums, and a newly restarted source-checked English Expose X tranche through printed p524.

What changed: since #605 / idx608, 37 directly checked source pages cover Expose XII and continue Expose XIII through p17. The pagewise pass restores omitted authored text, proofs, displays, arrows, notation, emphasis, and paragraph structure; reverses paraphrase or condensation where encountered; and corrects source-level mathematical errors. Material after idx645 remains inherited scaffold and is not certified merely because it appears in the compiled reader.

Status: this is substantive source-aware working material, not OCR-only, but it is not a critical edition, completed SGA6 release, whole-volume source-faithfulness certification, synchronized English edition, publication-grade proofread edition, or diagram-by-diagram certification. The 378-page French PDF has zero fatal errors, zero overfull boxes, zero underfull boxes, no missing characters, and no unresolved references. SGA5 remains incomplete and contains known errors. SGA7 remains partial and caveat-heavy. Output page count is not a completion metric because source restoration and layout reflow can add or remove pages.

Corrections can be proposed through the GitHub mirror: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
notes: Reader-first SGA surface with frozen SGA6 source-rescribe checkpoint through ledger entry #662 / idx645 and a source-checked English Expose X restart through printed p524. Not a completed or critical edition, global source-faithfulness certification, synchronized English edition, or diagram-by-diagram certification.
